title: New Haven Nighthawks: filling the ballpark
prompt: Our client is the New Haven Nighthawks, a minor-league baseball team. Most weekday games have empty seats, but weekend games sell out. The owner wants to know how to change ticket prices to make more money.

clarifying_answers.objective: Increase total game-day revenue this season.
clarifying_answers.constraints: The league allows teams to set their own prices. The owner wants to stay family-friendly.
clarifying_answers.revenue_sources: Tickets, plus food and merchandise sold at the park.

hidden_facts.hint: attendance, capacity, or how full games are
hidden_facts.fact: The stadium has 6,000 seats. Weekend games sell out; weekday games average 2,500 fans.

hidden_facts.hint: the schedule or number of games
hidden_facts.fact: There are 70 home games: 20 on weekends and 50 on weekdays.
Every seat costs $15, whatever the day.

hidden_facts.hint: weekend demand, waitlists, or resale prices
hidden_facts.fact: The weekend waitlist and resale prices suggest weekend fans would pay $22 without attendance dropping.

hidden_facts.hint: past price experiments or lower weekday prices
hidden_facts.fact: A weekday test at $10 raised attendance to 4,000.

hidden_facts.hint: food, merchandise, or spending per fan
hidden_facts.fact: Each fan spends about $12 on food and merchandise.

math_answers.question: What is ticket revenue for the season today?
How much more does a weekday game make at $10, counting food and merchandise?
What is the total extra revenue for the season with $22 weekends and $10 weekdays?
math_answers.formula: (weekend_games * seats * (weekend_price_new - price) + weekday_games * (weekday_fans_test * (weekday_price_test + concessions_per_fan) - weekday_fans * (price + concessions_per_fan))) / 1000

ideal_structure: Revenue = fans x (ticket + food and merchandise), by day type
Weekends: demand above capacity, so raise price
Weekdays: empty seats, so lower price to fill and earn on food
recommendation: Use two prices: $22 on weekends and $10 on weekdays. Weekend fans will pay more, and cheaper weekday tickets bring in 1,500 more fans, each spending $12 on food and merchandise. Together that adds about $1.9M a season. Keep a family pack to stay family-friendly.
common_mistakes: Forgetting food and merchandise revenue when lowering weekday prices
